Back to Apple SAT

Bring your own question library.

Apple SAT keeps your study profile and progress in your browser. The clean repository starts without personal records or question PDFs.

Load a PDF question collection

In the repository, install the two Python requirements, then run the importer with the path to your own PDF collection. The importer creates the question assets and answer metadata used by the website.

python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python scripts/import_pdf_bank.py --pdf-root "/path/to/SAT Question Bank PDFs"
python -m http.server 8000 --directory dist

The importer supports the formatted question and answer-key layout described in the repository README. It checks IDs, matches question images, and keeps a source citation for each item.

Add your information

Open Study profile to enter your scores, target, and test date, or import a profile JSON or tutoring_state.json file. Use Export progress to save a backup for another browser or your tutor.
